timeline.title: Travel to End Location
notes_and_tips: Ample transfer and travel time allocated for travelers to collect any stored luggage, make their way to their departure terminal, airport, or onward connection, concluding the trip in Kyoto by 6:00 PM.

warnings: Budget Tier Preference Compromise: Alice prefers Tier 2 (moderate) while Bob prefers Tier 3 (upscale). Lodging is balanced at stylish 4-star properties (Hotel Gracery Shinjuku and Cross Hotel Kyoto) offering upscale comfort at sensible mid-range rates, while dining emphasizes authentic casual and boutique eateries.

Morning Routine Preference Compromise: Alice prefers early departures (6:00 AM – 8:00 AM) while Bob prefers late starts (10:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Departures are set around 8:30 AM to 8:45 AM, giving Bob extra rest while allowing Alice independent early morning hours.

Day 2 & Day 3 Splits Implemented: Tailored branches have been generated for requested split IDs (d2-nezu-yanaka, d2-ueno-park, and d3-meiji-jingu). Alice's priority for self-guided, authentic cultural walking paths is preserved, while Bob gets dedicated parallel branches catering to his preferences for popular sights, boutique shopping on Takeshita Street and Ameyoko, and the Tokyo National Museum.
